item.text:
This pass found a new High recovery-selection defect.

**F28 — no-command Accept claims a value ballot it does not hold.** `handleAccept` advances `inst.vbal` even when the acceptor has no command, leaving `Status=NONE` with an empty value. Its later PrepareReply can therefore outrank a replica that actually holds a preaccepted value. The focused test fails with `status=0 bal=5 vbal=5 cmds=[]` ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/audit_accept_novalue_output.txt)).

`diagnostic_fix18/` sets `vbal` only when a command is held. The focused test and cluster controls pass, and the 500-seed campaign remains **406 pass / 94 NOOP / 0 divergence** ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix18_campaign500_output.txt)). The command-holding acceptor still needs F4’s status fix.

The audit is now at **28 findings**, **43 failing finding tests**, and **5 passing controls**; `run_audit.sh` asserts those counts, builds, reruns the race check, and confirms captured source unchanged.
